counting: Distinct OpenAlex work identifiers within Q/F/B. Preprint and proceedings may have separate IDs. S01 verifies known DOIs without a date filter and adds no IDs to discovery counts. Work type and date are verbatim OpenAlex metadata.

stages.B: One backward pass from seven selected works, de-duplicating their cited OpenAlex IDs, followed by the date filter in eight batches.
